name: RHB Bank Berhad
overview: 今年 RHB Bank 的业务变化主要体现为子公司精简：Utama Assets Sdn Bhd 于 9 月解散，Ke-Zan Nominees (Tempatan) Sdn Bhd 于 1 月解散，两者均不再为集团子公司。公告中未披露各业务板块的扩张、新业务或合约事项。
overview_en: RHB Bank's main business changes this year were subsidiary streamlining: Utama Assets Sdn Bhd was dissolved in September and Ke-Zan Nominees (Tempatan) Sdn Bhd was dissolved in January, with both ceasing to be subsidiaries of the group. The announcements did not disclose any expansion, new business or contract matters for the business segments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年公告涉及两家子公司的解散，未涉及具体业务板块的扩张或收缩。
segments.note_en: This year's announcements involved the dissolution of two subsidiaries and did not involve expansion or contraction of specific business segments.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 Utama Assets Sdn Bhd 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日根据《2016 年公司法》第 459(5) 条解散，不再为 RHB Bank 子公司。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Utama Assets Sdn Bhd was dissolved on 10 September 2026 pursuant to Section 459(5) of the Companies Act 2016 and ceased to be a subsidiary of RHB Bank.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Ke-Zan Nominees (Tempatan) Sdn Bhd 于 2026 年 1 月 2 日根据《2016 年公司法》第 459(5) 条解散，不再为 RHB Bank 间接全资子公司。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Ke-Zan Nominees (Tempatan) Sdn Bhd was dissolved on 2 January 2026 pursuant to Section 459(5) of the Companies Act 2016 and ceased to be an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of RHB Bank.
